7332.title: Code-fence host schedules a synchronous portal follow-up commit
7332.rootCauseOneLine: A claimed placeholder calls host.update in a layout effect; its initially empty entry triggers rerender before paint, even when the renderer returns null.
7332.proposedFix: Profile an isolated two-pane thread switch on current main and attribute layout reads before changing the host lifecycle; preserve streaming renderer identity, ordering, fallback, and detach cleanup.
7332.caveats: Two clean checkouts confirm the synchronous follow-up commit only. No Chromium timing or forced-layout amplification was measured; the 1.2-1.3 second penalty and ancestor row-effect claims remain unverified. No fix PR: the full performance defect has not been reproduced on trusted main.
